errors.input: Check the highlighted fields and try again.
errors.notFound: This item no longer exists or you can no longer see it. Refresh the page.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this at the same time. Refresh the page to see their change.
errors.invalid: One of the values is not accepted. Check it and try again.
errors.unexpected: The change could not be saved. Try again, or contact support if it keeps happening.

refusals.other: The database refused this change. The rule below names why.
refusals.partner_is_client: A client org cannot have clients of its own, so it sets no default client brand.
refusals.partner_client_unknown: That org is not one of your clients.
refusals.partner_price_client_immutable: A price stays with its client. Set a price for the other client instead.
refusals.partner_depth: A partner cannot have a parent partner, and an org with clients cannot become a client.
refusals.partner_agreement_missing: Wholesale billing starts once the platform records your partner agreement. Contact your account manager.
refusals.partner_no_clients: Create a client org before running wholesale billing.
refusals.wholesale_period_month: A wholesale statement covers a calendar month. Pick its first day.
refusals.wholesale_period_future: A month is billed once it has started.
refusals.wholesale_statement_exists: This month is already billed. Its statement is listed below.
refusals.support_session_no_partner: Only a client org grants its partner a support session.
refusals.support_session_hours: A support session lasts from 1 to 24 hours.
refusals.support_session_reason: Say why the partner needs access, in up to 500 characters.
refusals.support_session_active: A support session is already open. End it before granting another.
refusals.support_session_ended: This support session has already ended.
refusals.support_session_immutable: A support session can only be ended early, once.
refusals.brand_contrast: This accent fails WCAG 2.2 AA contrast in at least one theme. Choose a darker or lighter accent.
refusals.slug_taken: That web address is already in use. Choose another.
refusals.slug_reserved: That web address is reserved by the platform. Choose another.
refusals.plan_limit_exceeded: Your plan's limit is reached. Upgrade the plan or remove something first.
refusals.seat_limit_reached: All seats on your plan are in use. Buy extra seats in Billing and Plan, or upgrade the plan. Viewer and Field roles never take a seat.
refusals.seat_limit_upgrade: All seats on your plan are in use, and it sells no extra seats. Upgrade the plan in Billing and Plan. Viewer and Field roles never take a seat.
refusals.plan_feature_required: Your plan does not include this. Upgrade the plan to use it.
refusals.import_xls_unsupported: Older .xls files cannot be read. Save the sheet as .xlsx or .csv and upload it again.
refusals.import_file_size: The spreadsheet is larger than 10 MB. Split it into smaller files.
refusals.import_field_twice: Two columns map to the same field. Map each field once and skip the other column.
refusals.import_upload_owner: An import reads a spreadsheet you uploaded yourself. Upload it again.
refusals.import_field_unknown: That field is not part of this import's target.
refusals.import_mapping_confirmation: The mapping was already confirmed for this import.
refusals.import_status_service_only: This import is being processed. Wait for the current step to finish.
refusals.import_job_immutable: An import keeps its file and target. Start a new import instead.
refusals.import_not_validated: Only a validated import is committed. Wait for validation, or start again.
refusals.import_merge_reviews_pending: Decide every possible duplicate before committing.
refusals.import_nothing_to_commit: No row is valid. Fix the spreadsheet and import it again.
refusals.merge_review_person: Only a person decides a possible duplicate.
refusals.import_batch_not_undoable: Only a committed batch that was not undone can be undone.
refusals.import_undo_window: A batch can be undone for 7 days after it was committed.
refusals.import_undo_reason: Say why the batch is undone.
refusals.custom_choices_required: A Choice field needs at least one option, one per line.
refusals.custom_value_type: A value does not match its field's type. Check dates, numbers and amounts.
refusals.custom_value_email: That is not an email address.
refusals.custom_value_url: That is not an http or https address.
refusals.custom_value_field: That field belongs to another object.
refusals.custom_value_choice: That option belongs to another field.
refusals.custom_value_person: A person value names a member of this org.
refusals.custom_object_key_immutable: An object key is part of its API routes and never changes.
refusals.view_as_role_unknown: Preview a platform role or one of this org's roles.
refusals.explain_table_unknown: Only records of this org can be explained.
refusals.org_name_mismatch: Type the organization's name exactly as shown to confirm.
refusals.org_cancel_reason: Say why the organization is canceled, in up to 1,000 characters.
refusals.org_cancel_has_clients: A partner with client orgs cannot cancel. Move each client to direct billing first.
refusals.org_reactivation_window: An organization can be reactivated during the 30 days after it was canceled.
refusals.org_read_only: This organization is read-only right now. The banner at the top of the page says why and what lifts it.
refusals.inbox_action_unknown: An Inbox item is approved, rejected or marked Done.
refusals.inbox_action_not_offered: Only an approval request is approved or rejected from the Inbox.
refusals.inbox_snooze_window: Snooze an item for up to 30 days.
refusals.approval_not_step_approver: You are not an approver of the step this approval is waiting on.
refusals.approval_approver_capability: Approving this document needs its approval capability.
refusals.approval_one_step_per_approver: You already decided a step of this approval. The next step needs another approver.
refusals.approval_rejection_reason: Say why when you reject an approval.
refusals.sod_approval_requester: You requested this approval, so someone else decides it.

imports.canceled: This import was canceled. Nothing was written.

failed.body: The file could not be read or written. Check that it is a .csv or .xlsx spreadsheet and start a new import.

failed.scanFailed: This file could not be checked for viruses, so it was not read. Save it again as .csv or .xlsx and start a new import.

lifecycle.ownerOnly: Only the Owner cancels the organization or takes the full export.

canceled.title: Canceled and read-only
canceled.body: {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} left, until {until}. Download the full export before then. Data is deleted on {purge}.

cancel.title: Cancel the organization
cancel.explain: Take the full export first if you need a copy now; it stays available for 30 days after canceling.

export.help: One archive with JSON and CSV for every record, the stored files and a manifest.
